pages.text: In the lively town of Sunpur, <name> loved visiting her school garden. But one morning, she frowned — wrappers, plastic bottles, and paper bits were scattered everywhere. The marigolds drooped sadly. “Oh no,” she sighed. “Our garden looks so messy!”

Just then, a funny whirr-click-buzz! sound came from behind the peepal tree. Out rolled a round, silver robot with blinking eyes and a cheerful grin. “Namaste! I’m Robo-11, your friendly helper!” he said in a wobbly metallic voice.

<name> giggled. “Hi, Robo! Can you help me clean the garden?” Robo saluted with his tiny metal hand. “Cleaning mode activated — vroom-vroom!” Together, they got to work. Robo zipped around on his little wheels, slurping up trash with a zoooop! and sorting it neatly into shiny boxes labeled “Plastic,” “Paper,” and “Recycling.”

<name> picked up dry leaves and watered the flowers. Soon, curious classmates joined in. “Wow, <name>! Your robot is awesome!” said Riya. When they finished, the garden sparkled again — butterflies fluttered, and the jasmine flowers smelled sweet. Robo beeped proudly. “Mission clean and green — complete!”

But Robo wasn’t done. He unfolded a small arm and said, “Now… invention time!” He connected his sensor to a broken tap near the playground and click! — clean water started flowing again. Everyone clapped and cheered. <name> smiled brightly. “Robo, you don’t just clean — you care!” Robo’s eyes twinkled. “Helping is my favorite power!”

That afternoon, the whole school gathered to thank <name> and Robo. The principal said, “You’ve shown us that curiosity and teamwork can make our world better.” As the sun set, Robo beeped softly, “Adventure complete, partner.” <name> patted his shiny head. “Let’s find our next mission tomorrow!” The garden shimmered in the golden light — clean, happy, and full of promise.
